newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria railway delays electric link project.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria railway delays electric link project.

text.p: The Bulgarian State Railway (BSR) has suspended the electrification of a link to the Serbian border because a local bank has blocked its cash, its director general said on Wednesday.

"The Trade and Savings Bank (TSB) has blocked our deposit of more than 250 million levs ($1.1 million) which were due to go towards the electrification of our railway link from Sofia to Dragoman (Bulgaria's check-point on the Serbian border)," Anguel Dimitrov said.
"We plan to complete the link's electrification by the end of the year," he said. Its completion had initially been set for this month.
Dimitrov did not say how the BSR would pay for the project if the bank, known to have financial difficulties, did not unblock the company's deposit.

The BSR also cannot receive another 226 million levs from the TSB, which are part of a one billion lev loan from the State Fund for Reconstruction and Development extended for reconstruction and modernisation of the railways, Dimitrov said.
The BSR is now using the Biohim Bank due to the TSB's difficulties.
